o1: Predicted to enable signaling receptor binding activity. Involved in several processes, including axon guidance; establishment or maintenance of actin cytoskeleton polarity; and regulation of axon guidance. Acts upstream of or within dendrite morphogenesis. Is located in axon; basement membrane; and cytoplasm. Is expressed in several structures, including P1; P10; accessory cell; muscle cell; and neurons; predicted to be expressed in ventral cells. Predicted to be part of netrin-mediated signaling pathway. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in congenital mirror movement disorder. Orthologous to several human genes including NTN1 (netrin 1).
